n.description: Degree of polynomial power function f(x) = x^n

k.description: Shift for axis of rotation x = k (to the left: x = -k)

constraints: Tests setup diagnostic: integrand expression 2*pi*r(x)*h(x) without evaluating limits
promptTemplate: Consider the region bounded by f(x) = x^{{n}}, the x-axis, between x = 0 and x = 1, revolved around the line x = -{k}. Express the simplified integrand (including 2*pi) for finding the volume using the shell method.

hints.template: Identify the shell radius r(x) from the line x = -{k} and the shell height h(x).
The radius is r(x) = x - (-{k}) = x + {k}, and the height is h(x) = x^{{n}}.
Multiply the terms: 2 * pi * (x + {k}) * x^{{n}} = 2 * pi * (x^{{n}+1} + {k}*x^{{n}}).
